basis: Defined by paraneoplastic involvement of joints, bones, skeletal muscles or connective tissue; an immune mechanism is not universal.
Inherited mineral-processing disorders; no additional organ is consistently damaged across this heterogeneous umbrella.
Vertebral closure defect with spinal cord and nerve injury; hydrocephalus shares the neurologic axis; secondary renal damage is not universal.
Paragonimus infection directly involves the lungs; reactive eosinophilia does not establish a separate blood disorder.
Degeneration or inflammation of peripheral sensory nerves; an immune cause is not established for the umbrella.
Inflammatory cerebral vasculitis with multiple CNS infarctions explicitly defining this rapidly progressive subtype.
Glycosylation defect with platelet and neutrophil abnormalities; pulmonary hemorrhage 80-99%; neurologic involvement frequency is uncertain.
Sulfatide storage causes central and peripheral demyelination; optic atrophy 30-79%; cholecystitis occurs in only 5-29%.
Carcinoma originating in the exocrine pancreatic ducts; metastatic sites are not defining organs.
Reported phenotype emphasizes congenital heart defects and skeletal malformations; CNS anomalies are variable and their frequency is uncertain.
CARD14-associated psoriasis is an immune-mediated inflammatory skin disease; no common intrinsic extra-cutaneous damage is established.
Neoplasm arising in or directly occupying the spinal cord.
Yersinia pestis bloodstream infection; blood involvement defines the septicemic form.
Isolated congenital duplication of central fingers; a structural limb malformation.
Angiopathy, nephropathy and myopathy define HANAC; lacunar strokes 4/9; retinal tortuosity is common but retinal hemorrhage occurs in <30%.
Metabolic crystal deposition in articular cartilage and joints causes inflammatory arthropathy.
Storage disorder defined by angiokeratomas and sensory neuropathy; hearing loss 30-79%; corneal opacity and cardiomegaly 30-79% omitted under the cap.
Painful subcutaneous lipomas define disease; arthralgia does not establish joint damage; neuropathy 5-29%; obesity and lipid abnormalities are associated.
Myelodysplastic/myeloproliferative neoplasm of marrow and circulating myeloid cells; splenic involvement remains within the blood axis.
Neurodevelopmental and hypothalamic endocrine syndrome; strabismus/visual impairment and scoliosis each 30-79%; hypopigmentation does not imply skin damage.
Obesity and hypopigmentation define the syndrome; steatosis reported in 1/1 is separately diagnosed obesity-associated liver disease.
Cerebellar/brainstem malformation; oculomotor apraxia is neurologic; hepatic fibrosis 2/7, retinal damage occasional; nephropathy 1/1 gives uncertain prevalence.
Defining limb and skeletal malformations accompany cleft palate and abnormal oral frenula; oral structures belong to gastrointestinal.
Congenital cardiac valve dysplasia with stenosis, regurgitation and arterial abnormalities; pulmonary valve and artery are cardiovascular.
Inherited hair-follicle disorder causing sparse scalp and body hair; sparse hair reported in 19/19 patients.
